SELECT packageTitle, regTitle, startDt, regPrice, salesQty, orderCnt, soldAmt, regId FROM ( SELECT t.packageTitle, t.regTitle, t.startDt, t.regPrice, t.salesQty, t.orderCnt, t.soldAmt, t.regId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY
t.soldAmt DESC, t.startDtDate DESC, t.regId DESC
t.soldAmt ASC, t.startDtDate DESC, t.regId DESC
t.startDtDate DESC, t.regId DESC
) AS rn FROM ( SELECT pkg.PACKAGE_TITLE AS packageTitle, rp.REG_TITLE AS regTitle, rp.START_DT AS startDtDate, TO_CHAR(rp.START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDt, rp.REG_PRICE AS regPrice, NVL(SUM(oi.ORDER_QTY), 0) AS salesQty, COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_NO) AS orderCnt, NVL(SUM(oi.ITEM_TOTAL), 0) AS soldAmt, rp.REG_ID AS regId FROM REGISTER_PROD rp JOIN PACKAGES pkg ON pkg.PACKAGE_ID = rp.PACKAGE_ID JOIN ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.REG_ID = rp.REG_ID JOIN ORDERS o ON o.ORDER_NO = oi.ORDER_NO JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_NO, MAX(PAID_AT) AS PAID_AT FROM PAYMENT WHERE PAY_STATUS = 'PAID' AND PAID_AT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ORDER_NO ) pay ON pay.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE pkg.PACKAGE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{packageTitle} || '%'
AND pay.PAID_AT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND pay.PAID_AT < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
GROUP BY pkg.PACKAGE_TITLE, rp.REG_TITLE, rp.START_DT, rp.REG_PRICE, rp.REG_ID ) t ) WHERE rn BETWEEN ((#{page} - 1) * #{size} + 1) AND (#{page} * #{size})

SELECT DISTINCT pkg.PACKAGE_ID AS packageId, pkg.PACKAGE_TITLE AS packageTitle FROM PACKAGES pkg WHERE 1=1
AND pkg.PACKAGE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY pkg.PACKAGE_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT rp.REG_ID AS regId, rp.REG_TITLE AS regTitle, TO_CHAR(rp.START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDt, NVL(SUM(oi.ITEM_TOTAL), 0) AS soldAmt, COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_NO) AS orderCnt FROM REGISTER_PROD rp LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.REG_ID = rp.REG_ID LEFT JOIN ORDERS o ON o.ORDER_NO = oi.ORDER_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_NO, MAX(PAID_AT) AS PAID_AT FROM PAYMENT WHERE PAY_STATUS = 'PAID' AND PAID_AT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ORDER_NO ) pay ON pay.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE rp.PACKAGE_ID = #{packageId}
AND (pay.PAID_AT IS NULL OR ( pay.PAID_AT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND pay.PAID_AT < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 ))
GROUP BY rp.REG_ID, rp.REG_TITLE, rp.START_DT ORDER BY
soldAmt DESC, rp.START_DT DESC
soldAmt ASC, rp.START_DT DESC
rp.START_DT DESC

TO_CHAR(pay.PAID_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(TRUNC(pay.PAID_AT, 'IW'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(pay.PAID_AT, 'IW') + 6, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(pay.PAID_AT, 'YYYY-MM') AS period, rp.REG_ID AS seriesKey, rp.REG_TITLE AS seriesLabel, NVL(SUM(oi.ITEM_TOTAL), 0) AS soldAmt, COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_NO) AS orderCnt FROM REGISTER_PROD rp JOIN ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.REG_ID = rp.REG_ID JOIN ORDERS o ON o.ORDER_NO = oi.ORDER_NO JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_NO, MAX(PAID_AT) AS PAID_AT FROM PAYMENT WHERE PAY_STATUS = 'PAID' AND PAID_AT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ORDER_NO ) pay ON pay.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE rp.PACKAGE_ID = #{packageId}
AND pay.PAID_AT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND pay.PAID_AT < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND rp.REG_ID IN
#{rid}
GROUP BY
TO_CHAR(pay.PAID_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(TRUNC(pay.PAID_AT, 'IW'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(pay.PAID_AT, 'IW') + 6, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(pay.PAID_AT, 'YYYY-MM') , rp.REG_ID, rp.REG_TITLE

SELECT

TO_CHAR(TRUNC(rp.START_DT, 'IW'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(rp.START_DT, 'IW') + 6, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
